usage.guide: Do not use via the x402 registry. POST https://api.anchorbrowser.io/v1/sessions returns HTTP 401 'Unauthorized, please log in.' and never issues an x402 402 payment challenge, so the keyless wallet cannot pay for it. It requires Anchor Browser's own API key / login, which the no-API-key policy excludes. This endpoint should be dropped or pruned from the registry.
